_comment: People's decisions about the demo KB, applied by `manage.py load_demo_kb`. Risk tiers are set when an article is first created; after that only KbArticle.set_risk_tier changes them. Each auto_reply approval is pinned to the SHA-256 (from manifest.json) of the text that was reviewed: if the page changes, the loader does not apply it and revokes an existing one. Only risk tier 'low' may be approved.

auto_reply.reason: Self-service password reset steps for the AWS access portal; no privileged action, user-facing, low risk.
End-user AWS VPN Client fixes on Windows (reconnect, adapters, profiles); changes nothing server-side, low risk.
SSH connection troubleshooting for EC2 Linux; diagnostic steps for the instance owner, no access grant, low risk.
WorkSpaces client troubleshooting for end users (registration code, login, network errors), low risk.
Lambda invocation error reference for function owners; explains causes, grants no permissions, low risk.
